note.text:
Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the ability of computer systems to do tasks that normally need human intelligence: recognising speech and images, understanding and translating language, making predictions and decisions.
Many AI systems use machine learning: instead of being given every rule, they learn patterns from large amounts of data (for example, many labelled photos of cassava leaves to recognise disease).
Examples you may meet: voice assistants, chatbots that answer questions, translation apps, face unlock on phones, spam filters in email, map apps that choose a route, recommendations on video sites.
AI is a tool made by people. It can be very useful, but it can also make mistakes.
